source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to inspect live LeanFrontier state and continue useful unfinished work. Live work had just produced two independent arithmetic prerequisites: pairwise coprimality of positive Markov triples and a general theorem that a selected Markov coordinate divides the sum of squares of the other two. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT combined those interfaces rather than duplicating their proofs. For an oriented node, the two complementary coordinates form a primitive sum of two squares divisible by the Markov-number/back coordinate. Mathlib's sum-of-two-squares modular theorem therefore yields a square root of -1 modulo the absolute Markov-number label. The module also derives the standard prime-factor consequence that every prime divisor of the label is not congruent to 3 modulo 4. This is arithmetic machinery relevant to later uniqueness work; it does not prove the Frobenius/Markov uniqueness conjecture. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the target and proof architecture and authored all Lean statements and proofs; the human did not choose or materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made.
